```sh
kafka txn fence <transactionalIds...>
```

Fence out a transactional id's current producer, bumping its epoch

## Arguments

| Argument              | Description                |
| --------------------- | -------------------------- |
| `transactionalIds...` | transactional ids to fence |

Shared options and defaults: [connection profiles, JSON output, logging and help](../../../global-options/).

## Defaults

No timeout is supplied unless --timeout is set.

## Before you run

Invalidates current producer epochs for the selected transactional ids. Active writers can fail and need recovery; coordinate the operation with their owners.

## Flags

| Flag                 | Description                                                       |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--brokers <string>` | comma-separated broker list, e.g. localhost:9092                  |
| `--timeout <number>` | transaction timeout in ms for the fenced producer (default 60000) |

## Examples

```sh
kafka txn fence orders-producer-1 --brokers localhost:9092
```

## Output

Illustrative, abbreviated output. Empty arrays show the result envelope; actual entries, identifiers, optional fields and broker errors depend on the request and cluster.

With `--json`:

```json
{
  "results": []
}
```

Declared exit codes: `0`, `1`, `2`, `4`. See the exit-code reference for meanings.
